prompt_text: AI to draft donor thank you letters
response_text:
Certainly! Here’s a template for creating a donor thank you letter. You can customize the details according to your organization's needs and the specifics of the donation.

---

[Your Organization’s Letterhead or Logo]

[Date]

[Donor's Name]  
[Donor's Address]  
[City, State, ZIP Code]

Dear [Donor's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. On behalf of [Your Organization’s Name], I wanted to extend our heartfelt thanks for your generous donation of [Donation Amount] on [Date of Donation]. Your support is crucial to our mission and enables us to continue [briefly describe what your organization does, e.g., "providing educational resources to underprivileged children"].

This past [time period], with contributions from kind donors like you, we have been able to [mention any recent achievements or developments related to your organization’s mission]. Your donation will directly help us [mention any specific projects or areas that the donation will support, e.g., "launch a new after-school program," "provide meals for families in need," etc.].

We are deeply grateful for your commitment to our cause and for joining us in our efforts to make a difference. Thanks to your generosity, we are able to continue our work and impact even more lives. 

We would like to invite you to [mention any upcoming events, meetings, or visits]. It’s a great opportunity to see firsthand the impact of your contributions and meet others who share your passion for [mention your cause].

Once again, thank you for your support and trust. We look forward to continuing this impactful journey together.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Position/Title]  
[Your Organization’s Name]  
[Contact Information]

P.S. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or if you would like more information on how your donation is making a difference.

---

Feel free to modify the template as needed depending on your organization's style and the specific relationship you have with the donor.
